intro.heading: For conferences, youth forums, universities, and international platforms.
intro.text: Mohamed's speaking work connects meaningful youth involvement, youth mental health, education, civic participation, and institutional decision-making. His profile combines field leadership, clinical training, facilitation, and representation in high-visibility national and international spaces.
proofPoints: UN General Assembly youth representative and speaker
TEDx speaker across multiple youth and education events
Moderator and CME-accredited participant at the World Congress of Psychiatry
Workshop coordinator and facilitator for youth, education, and mental health platforms
